en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquaint with importance of vegetables in human diet, with scale of production in CZ and world. To acquaint with production systems in vegetables.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Vegetable importance for human diet. Nutritive and antinutritive compounds. (allowance 2/2)2.History and scale of vegetable production in CZ, EU, in world. (allowance 2/2)3.Vegetable origin, classification. Yield and biomass formation. (allowance 2/2)4.Demands of vegetable to climate - temperature, light, water. (allowance 2/2)5.Demands for edaphic factors - soil, fertilization and nutrition. Use of plastics. (allowance 2/2)6.Vegetable crops rotation, principles, benefits. (allowance 2/2)7.Integrated and organic cultivation systems of vegetable. (allowance 2/2)8.Seed, quality assurance, preparation, pre-treatment. (allowance 2/2)9.Methods of planting preparation, keeping of young plants. (allowance 2/2)10.Agrotechnical demands, direct sowing, planting, weeds limitation. (allowance 2/2)11.Harvest, postharvest processing of vegetables, market preparation - expedition, handling. (allowance 2/2)12.Mushroom, oyster cultivation. Asparagus culture. (allowance 2/2)13.Excursion to the vegetable farms. (allowance 0/0)
